scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Welcome to ^8B4513Izlude^000000,
Prontera's satellite town.
Do you need help navigating the town?
scripts.translation:
[依斯鲁得向导]
欢迎来到^8B4513依斯鲁得岛^000000，
普隆德拉的卫星城镇。
需要我帮您指引城镇内的路线吗？

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Novice adventurers should go to {0} to receive more information and training!
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[依斯鲁得向导]
初心者冒险者应该前往{0}，
那里可以提供更多信息和训练！
您还想查看其他地点吗？

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
You can use the {0}
to go to ^8B4513Alberta^000000 or ^8B4513Byalan Island^000000.
Beware of ^8B4513Izlude Dungeon^000000
on Byalan Island since it is
filled with dreadful monsters.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[依斯鲁得向导]
您可以乘坐{0}
前往^8B4513艾尔贝塔^000000或^8B4513拜兰岛^000000。
请注意拜兰岛上的^8B4513依斯鲁得迷宫^000000，
那里充满了可怕的魔物。
您还想查看其他地点吗？

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
The {0}
goes to ^8B4513Juno^000000 and ^8B4513Rachel^000000.
Let me mark its location
on your mini-map.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[依斯鲁得向导]
{0}
可以前往^8B4513朱诺^000000和^8B4513拉赫^000000。
让我在您的小地图上标记它的位置。
您还想查看其他地点吗？

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
The {0}
is a perfect place to
test your combat capabilities.
Let me mark its location
on your mini-map.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[依斯鲁得向导]
{0}
是测试您战斗能力的绝佳场所。
让我在您的小地图上标记它的位置。
您还想查看其他地点吗？

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
The {0} is where you can ^800080change your job to Swordsman.^000000
Let me mark its location
on your mini-map.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[依斯鲁得向导]
在{0}
您可以^800080转职为剑士。^000000
让我在您的小地图上标记它的位置。
您还想查看其他地点吗？

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
The {0}
is currently staying inside
the Swordsman Guild building.
Let me mark his location on your mini-map.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[依斯鲁得向导]
{0}
目前正待在剑士公会建筑内。
让我在您的小地图上标记他的位置。
您还想查看其他地点吗？

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
If you'd like to go on a honeymoon to
^8B4513Jawaii^000000, the paradise of newlyweds,
please speak to the 
{0}.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[依斯鲁得向导]
如果您想去^8B4513爪哇^000000度蜜月，
那里是新婚夫妇的天堂，
请去和{0}
对话。
您还想查看其他地点吗？

scripts.text:
[Izlude Guide]
Sure, I'll remove all marks from your mini-map.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[依斯鲁得向导]
好的，我会移除您小地图上的所有标记。
还有其他我可以为您做的吗？

[依斯鲁得向导]
祝您旅途愉快。
再见~！
